friction.summary: MPT amount shapes differ per field: Asset is identity-only {mpt_issuance_id}, deposit/pay Amount is {mpt_issuance_id, value}, PrincipalRequested is a plain base-unit string. Easy to mix.
Redeem/VaultWithdraw via the wallet hung in a submitting state then reverted with no engine result surfaced, so success vs rejection vs drop was indistinguishable.
Unclear whether lending/vaults are native to XRPL or an amendment (XLS-65/66) that must be enabled.
Escrow has no on-chain link to a loan and release cannot be gated on default, so a collateral flow needs an off-ledger mapping and a desk-held fulfillment.

doc_questions.question: Isn't this project already done on XRPL? Isn't lending a basic feature of the chain?
What is the full recipe to provision an MPT-denominated vault market end to end?

workarounds.what: Asset abstraction mapping (asset, human value) to the correct XRP drops string or MPT {mpt_issuance_id, value} object
Off-ledger escrow-to-loan mapping plus a desk-held crypto-condition fulfillment for collateral

single_fix: An SDK helper that builds VaultDeposit/VaultWithdraw/LoanPay/cover amounts from (asset, human value), so developers cannot mix the identity-only Asset shape, the valued Amount object, and the plain PrincipalRequested string.
not_observed: Root cause of the VaultWithdraw hang (wallet timeout, dropped submission, or rejection): no engine result recorded.
Precise per-transaction latency: hook stored no elapsed times and most result codes as null this period.
Whether the developer used other Claude sessions or tools during the period (checkpoint mode does not ask).
